paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption_used: Distribution of articles across the three-year collection period (2017-2019), displayed as a pie chart with percentage and count labels. The 2019 cohort (blue) represents the largest share at 46.0% (46 articles), followed by 2018 (orange) at 33.0% (33 articles) and 2017 (green) at 21.0% (21 articles). The distribution reflects a steady annual increase, with the 2018-to-2019 growth rate of approximately 25% exceeding the 2017-to-2018 growth rate of roughly 35%. The combined 2017-2018 corpus accounts for slightly over half of all articles at 54%, suggesting that the collection effort intensified primarily in the final year.

model_annotations.English: The pie chart represents the distribution of articles across a three-year period, from 2017 to 2019. The chart is divided into three slices, representing the years 2017, 2018, and 2019. The slice for 2019 is blue and accounts for approximately 46% of the total, with a count of 46 articles. The slice for 2018 is orange and represents around 33% of the total, corresponding to 33 articles. The slice for 2017 is green and makes up about 21% of the total, with 21 articles. The chart includes percentage and count labels inside each slice. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice (2019) at the top, followed by 2018 and then 2017, visually presenting the proportions in descending order.
model_annotations.German: Das Kreisdiagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Artikeln über einen Zeitraum von drei Jahren, von 2017 bis 2019. Insgesamt werden drei Segmente dargestellt. Das Segment für 2019 ist blau gefärbt und macht etwa 46,0 % der Gesamtmenge aus, was 46 Artikeln entspricht. Das Segment für 2018 ist orange und stellt ungefähr 33,0 % dar, entsprechend 33 Artikeln. Das kleinste Segment, grün gefärbt, repräsentiert das Jahr 2017 mit etwa 21,0 %, was 21 Artikeln entspricht. Die Segmente sind in keiner bestimmten Reihenfolge angeordnet, aber ihre Größe nimmt ab, beginnend mit 2019. Prozentangaben und Artikelzahlen sind direkt in den jeweiligen Segmenten beschriftet.
